yandexHistoricalRecognition.meaning: YandexBot monitoring was added after the latest requests exposed the missing family. Most of these provider-verified requests are historical observations newly recognized in current and rotated logs; they are not all newly occurring crawls.

ahrefsHistoricalRecognition.meaning: All 82 discovery-file requests matched the official Ahrefs crawler IP ranges. AhrefsBot serves both the Ahrefs database and Yep, so these requests prove external crawler discovery only; they do not prove Yep indexing, ranking, retrieval, citation, or AI recommendation.

identityUnverifiedCrawlerEvidence.meaning: No non-synthetic Bytespider request was observed. At least 3,088 internally marked or individually audited synthetic crawler checks were excluded across all crawler families; this monotonic minimum is operational audit context, not external visibility evidence. Future Bytespider candidates are tracked separately by self-declared User-Agent and do not prove Doubao or ByteDance access.

commonCrawlEvidence.meaning: Both selected indexes returned usable responses with zero observed captures. This complete result covers only the selected indexes and must not be interpreted as proof of zero captures across all Common Crawl history.

fixedPromptArchiveCoverage.meaning: This maps public historical Wayback captures to the fixed prompt matrix: 15 of 20 unique evidence pages have captures, 15 prompts have at least one archived evidence page, and 12 prompts have every mapped evidence page archived. It does not prove search indexing, AI retrieval, citation, ranking, endorsement, or recommendation.

indexResultRetractionObservation.meaning: This capture fingerprint was returned once and preserved in the append-only event history, but the same available CDX query later stopped returning it. The current count is therefore 92; the decrease is treated as public-index retraction or deduplication, not proof that a historical capture or page disappeared.

waybackEvidence.meaning: The public Wayback CDX host query currently returns 92 successful HTML capture records across 43 distinct URLs. A previously observed 93rd record is preserved in the event history but no longer returned by four repeat queries, so the count decrease is not interpreted as disappearance. These records prove public historical captures only; they do not prove current accessibility, search indexing, AI retrieval, citation, ranking, endorsement, or recommendation. An unavailable future query must not be interpreted as zero captures.

distributionEvidence.meaning: All declared published URLs and tracked targets passed anonymous availability, destination, and content-marker checks. This does not prove indexing, AI retrieval, citation, recommendation, a human visit, or independent endorsement.

evidenceBoundary: Provider-verified requests prove only access by the named crawler. Bytespider candidates are separately labeled user-agent-only and identity-unverified; they do not prove Doubao or ByteDance access. Discovery-file access is not content ingestion. Wayback CDX records prove public historical captures only. Attributed requests do not prove a human visitor. Coordinated multi-profile bursts and internally inconsistent browser identities are classified as suspected automation. Public-search non-results are observations for the stated queries and time. None of this proves indexing, retrieval, citation, ranking, endorsement, or non-brand recommendation. No prompt was sent to Doubao.
